description: Convert docker run commands to a Docker Compose file and Compose services back. Operations: "to-compose" — Convert one or more docker run commands to Compose services (ports, volumes, env, name, restart, network, command).; "to-run" — Convert a Compose file (or one service) to a docker run command per service.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: to-compose: docker run commands; separate several with a blank line, ; or &&. to-run: A Compose file in YAML, or a single service mapping.

operation.description: to-compose — Convert one or more docker run commands to Compose services (ports, volumes, env, name, restart, network, command). to-run — Convert a Compose file (or one service) to a docker run command per service.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

detach.description: Add -d so each container runs in the background, as Compose does. Used by: to-run.

name: docker-compose
title: docker run to Compose Converter
